title: Trial Sprint Milestone Map and Blocker Log
content:
Context:
This doc is the working milestone map and blocker register for Customer Alpha's 4-week trial sprint. Purpose is to keep a single, lightweight source of truth for operations, quick decisions, and handoffs between Solutions Engineering, Customer Infra, and Platform. Treat as living notes — weekly stand notes get appended and stale items get archived to Confluence.

High-level outcome (customer-facing):
- Deliver an integrated Redwood-hosted endpoint with canary routing to the customer's dev VPC, validate latency under 95th perc target, and demonstrate cost vs quality tradeoffs with two quantized model variants. Acceptance: synthetic load + 3 user journeys passed, postmortem with metrics and recommended next-step plan.

Sprint breakdown (weeks):
Week 0 - Prep (pre-sprint, still in flight)
- Admin: contract signature and dataset access confirmed (Owner: Jamal, ETA: 2025-09-16)
- Baseline runbook & credentials exchange (Owner: Maya, ETA: 2025-09-18)

Week 1 - Integration and baseline metrics
- Deploy test model variant to sandbox; verify model artifact checksums and tokenization parity (Owner: Harish, ETA: 2025-09-19)
- Establish traffic shaping harness and load profile (Owner: Evelyn, ETA: 2025-09-21)
- Measure cold-start and warm-cache latencies (note: expect wide variance)

Week 2 - Performance tuning and canary routing
- Enable continuous batching and prefix caching; adjust batch windows for 95p latency target (Owner: Platform SRE; contact: Lena)
- Canary route 10% traffic from customer dev VPC to Redwood-Dedicated pool (Owner: Jamal, ETA: 2025-09-28)
- Run regression evals for quality drift vs quantized baseline (Owner: Harish)

Week 3 - Failure modes, resilience, and cost analysis
- Run graceful fallback tests (model variant fallback + multi-region reroute) (Owner: Evelyn, ETA: 2025-10-03)
- Produce cost-per-1k-token estimate for expected traffic shapes including caching effects (Owner: Maya)

Cross-cutting tasks and owners:
- Security review with customer: KMS/HSM mapping + audit log retention (Owner: Lena, linked: JIRA DEP-1293)
- Telemetry hooks: per-route tracing and token-level cost emitters (Owner: Harish)
- Runbook for incident handoff (Owner: Jamal)

Open blockers (live register):
1) Customer dataset anonymization not completed — blocks full quality evals. Impact: high; Likelihood: medium. Next step: Jamal to escalate to customer data lead; ETA 48h.
2) VPC peering IP overlap (customer dev VPC) — routes fail under partial mesh. Impact: high; Likelihood: low. Next step: Platform networking to propose CIDR remap; contact: Lena.
3) Model artifact fails quantization pipeline on latest checkpoint — leads to fallback to FP16 variant. Impact: medium; Likelihood: medium. Next step: Harish to open PR to pin older checkpoint and re-run quantization; blocker until 2025-09-20.

Meeting notes (standups):
- 2025-09-15: Kickoff recap. Customer wants end-to-end demo by week 4. Agreed to prioritize latency SLO and a concise test harness rather than exhaustive evals.
- 2025-09-18: Data access granted for synthetic subset; need anonymization checklist completed by 9/20. Action: Jamal follow up.

Decision log (executive crumbs):
- Canary size set to 10% after infra rehearsal showed flakiness at 20% on initial batch window.
- Default quantized profile will be Q4-normal unless quality regression exceeds 1.5x BLEU-like metric delta.

Risks and mitigations (short list):
- Risk: Latency regression under load due to KV cache eviction. Mitigation: increase per-worker KV cache cap for canary nodes and reduce config churn during test window.
- Risk: Cost overshoot from overly small batch windows. Mitigation: schedule a cost review daily during Week 2 and set hard budget alert thresholds.

Immediate next steps (48–72h):
- Jamal: confirm anonymization ETA and share scrub checklist (due 2025-09-17)
- Harish: re-run quantization on pinned checkpoint, push artifact to sandbox registry (due 2025-09-18)
- Lena: validate VPC route proposal and provide config snippet for customer (due 2025-09-19)
- Evelyn: finalize load profile script and smoke tests for canary (due 2025-09-19)

Appendix / quick refs:
- Smoke test command examples (use local harness under /scripts/harness-smoke.sh)
- Slack threads: #poc-cust-alpha-thread for live sync, #infra-requests for route changes
- Escalation: Platform Lead (Lena) -> Solutions Eng Manager (Maya) -> CTO for emergency capacity requests

Notes to self (informal):
- Keep this doc light; move final runbook and postmortem to Confluence at the end of sprint.
- Capture explicit token-level traces for the failing scenario to help quant team reproduce.
